test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the question that follows.

Seven students P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are standing in a row, from left to right in increasing order of their weights. P is standing at the middle position. R and V are at the second positions from the right and left sides, respectively. U is standing immediately after R. T is standing between R and P. S is at the third position from the least weight side.

Whose weight is minimum among all the students?
solution:
**Given:** Seven students P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are standing in a row, from left to right in increasing order of their weights. 

1) P is standing at the middle position.

2) R and V are at the second positions from the right and left sides, respectively. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08f92bdb7517c0ca35e69d52deda300ab4d2fd07c2e0d7dc32e3ccbde141bf65.png] 

3) T is standing between R and P.

4) S is at the third position from the least weight side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/580e16654e030f19236c55dcc9ff02b4ce4c02175399e5b477b85847d2d93c1f.png] 

5) U is standing immediately after R. 

After positioning U only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01c3d9f2de600cd4921b74894b1f371b78489cf8f22a5e9b37da374a58f47f7c.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Q's weight is minimum among all the students.

Hence,** "Option 2" **is the correct answer.
